blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Modern digital phenotyping pipelines require the precise measurement of a range of 3D morphological plant traits. The accurate, high throughput acquisition of these traits helps breeders and researchers accelerate the development of new varieties, techniques and products. Recent advances in 3D technologies have enabled a rapid transition from 2D to 3D pipelines, but high throughput acquisition of digital 3D twins of plants remains a significant challenge due to complex morphology, thin structures and occlusions. In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a new approach to generating 3D plants that leverages recent advances in video diffusion to produce high quality 3D Gaussian Splats of plants from a single image. We show that our method more accurately recreates plant morphology than other state-of-the-art methods, achieving the highest 3D F-score against all baselines, while being more practical for high throughput pipelines due to easier alignment and reduced cost of camera placement. Combined with a 2D diffusion model, we show that our method also achieves state-of-the-art results in the generation of 3D plant models from a text prompt.
blocks.zh: 现代数字回旋管需要精确地测量一系列3D形态植物特征. 准确,高吞吐量地获得这些特质有助于育种者和研究人员加速新品种,技术和产品的发展. 最近3D技术的进步使得从2D到3D管线的快速过渡,但由于形态复杂,结构较薄和被封存,高吞吐量收购了数位3D双胞胎植物仍然是一个重大挑战. 在本文中,我们介绍了"植物轨道器"(Plant Orbiter),这是一种生成3D植物的新方法,它利用了视频传播的最新进展,从一个单一的图像中产生出高质量的3D高斯平板植物. 我们显示,我们的方法比其他最先进的方法更准确地再造出植物形态,在所有基线上达到最高的3D F分数,同时对高通量的输油管更实用,因为对接更方便并降低相机放置成本. 结合二维扩散模型,我们显示,我们的方法还实现了从文字快取生成三维植物模型的最先进结果.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Digital 3D phenotyping presents substantial advantages in crop understanding over existing 2D analysis tools. Non-invasive methods for extracting accurate morphology enables a deep understanding of plant health [ 21 ] , and can accelerate the development of new varieties, as well as providing better monitoring tools for growers [ 19 ] . 3D plant analysis unlocks many of the most important measures for growers, such as leaf area, and fruit volume while handling occlusion for dense canopies better than can be achieved with a single view. Within mainstream computer vision, the rapid development of 3D reconstruction [ 44 , 27 ] and generation [ 70 , 80 ] techniques has already lead to widespread adoption of 3D models for both generation and analysis.
blocks.zh: 与现有的二维分析工具相比,数字三维麻黄在作物了解方面有很大优势。 提取准确形态学的非侵入性方法可以深入了解植物健康[21],并能加速新品种的开发,并为种植者提供更好的监测工具[19]. 3D植物分析解锁了许多对种植者最重要的措施,如叶片面积,水果体积,同时处理对密集树冠的封存比用单一视角可以实现的更好. 在主流计算机愿景中,立体重建[44,27]和生成[70,80]技术的快速发展已经导致广泛采用立体模型进行生成和分析.

blocks.en: Despite this, no current approach on plants achieves sufficient morphological accuracy, or the rapid acquisition, that would be required for the high throughput phenotyping pipelines at scale needed for agricultural settings. Existing methods in 3D plant capture often exhibit one of a range of limiting factors. Hardware dependant approaches such as laser scanners or robotic capture environments have high upfront costs, and are often low throughput. Multi-view methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) [ 44 ] or 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 27 ] directly learn a 3D representation from image sequences around a plant, but rely on computationally expensive camera recovery from structure-from-motion, which has high failure rates on complex biological structures. To tackle this, single image or monocular reconstruction methods have emerged in recent years to avoid the need for complex calibration of camera parameters. Image-to-3D generators [ 25 , 69 ] attempt to learn a direct mapping from a single image to a 3D model, but often suffer from poor performance on plants, and their output is challenging to realign and scale to the input image [ 14 ] . Novel view diffusion methods [ 8 , 65 ] , such as one included in our own pipeline, have not previously been applied to challenging domains like plants.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,目前对植物采取的任何办法都无法取得足够的形态精确度,也无法迅速获得农业环境所需的大规模高吞吐量螺旋管。 3D植物捕捉中的现有方法往往显示出一系列限制因素之一。 激光扫描仪或机器人捕捉环境等硬件依赖性方法具有较高的前期成本,而且经常是低吞吐量. 多视图方法如神经辐射场(NERF)[44]或3D高斯电镀(3DGS)[27]直接从一个植物周围的图像序列中学习到一个3D的表示,但依靠计算成本昂贵的相机从结构自运动中恢复,这在复杂的生物结构上有很高的故障率. 为了解决这个问题,近年来出现了单一的图像或单体重建方法,以避免需要复杂校准相机参数. 图像到3D生成器[25,69]试图学习从一个图像直接映射到一个3D模型,但经常受到植物性能不佳的影响,它们的输出很难调整和放大输入图像[14]. 小说视野传播方法[8,65],如我们自己的管道中包含的一种方法,以前没有应用于植物等具有挑战性的领域.

blocks.en: To improve the performance of reconstruction and other digital phenotyping tasks, the use of synthetic training data has proven increasingly popular due to a lack of available training datasets [ 64 , 18 ] . 3D data is often more challenging to produce and label, so this scarcity is even more pronounced and has motivated recent work in the generation of synthetic 3D plants using procedural and generative models [ 17 ] alongside wider research in text-to-3D models [ 80 , 77 ] . Despite recent advances, these methods suffer from high upfront costs, the need for hand-built per species rules, and in the case of generic models, poor performance on highly specific plant domains.
blocks.zh: 为了改善重建和其他数字编织工作的绩效,由于缺少可用的培训数据集[64,18],合成培训数据的使用被证明越来越受欢迎. 3D数据的制作和标签往往更具挑战性,因此这种稀缺性更加明显,并激励了最近利用程序和基因模型[17]与更广泛的文本对3D模型研究[80,77]一起,制造合成3D工厂的工作。 尽管最近取得了一些进步,但这些方法仍然面临高昂的前期成本,需要按物种规则手工制造,就通用模型而言,在非常具体的植物领域表现不佳。

blocks.en: In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a versatile pipeline for 3D reconstruction of accurate, automatically aligned plants. We leverage recent advances in video diffusion models to produce an accurate, geometrically consistent orbital video around the plant based on a single input image, from which 3D Gaussian splatting can produce an accurate model. Our method both reduces the practical and computational costs compared to multi-image capture setups, and recreates plants with higher geometric accuracy compared to previous camera guidance methods [ 81 , 65 ] .
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了工厂轨道器,这是一个多功能管道,用于3D重建准确的,自动对齐的工厂。 我们利用视频传播模型的最新进展,在工厂周围制作一个基于单一输入图像的准确,几何一致的轨道视频,从中3D高斯电镀可以产生准确的模型. 我们的方法既比多图像捕捉设置降低了实用成本和计算成本,又比以往的相机制导方法[81,65]更精确地重现了几何的工厂.

blocks.en: By prepending a text-to-image diffusion model to our pipeline, we also create a best in class model for the generation of entirely synthetic 3D plants that accurately adhere to a text prompt. We evaluate both the quality of synthetic plants but also the ability to prompt for specific phenotypic measurements, such as the number of fruits, and show that Plant Orbiter outperforms other leading text-to-3D models for both shape and prompt adherence.
blocks.zh: 通过将文本到图像的传播模型预先投入到我们的管道中,我们也创造了一种最好的类模型,用于生成完全合成的3D植物,精确地坚持文本提示. 我们既评估合成植物的质量,也评估是否有能力迅速进行具体的间皮测量,如水果数量,并表明植物轨道器在形状和迅速遵守方面都优于其他主要的文本到-3D模型。

blocks.en: The contributions of this paper can be summarised as follows: • A single image 3D reconstruction pipeline that achieves state-of-the-art geometric accuracy on reconstruction of plants. • Experimental results for highly accurate height estimation from single image reconstruction, showing that video diffusion methods using our pipeline outperform 3D generation methods. • A synthetic data generation pipeline that produces realistic synthetic plants, as well as experimental results showing our pipeline scores the highest for prompt adherence for phenotypical measurements.
blocks.zh: 本文件的贡献可归纳如下: • 单一的图像 3D 重建管道,在重建工厂方面实现最先进的几何精确度. · 从单一图像重建中得出高度精确估计的实验结果,显示使用输油管的视频传播方法超过了3D生成方法。 • 支助 生产现实合成植物的合成数据生成管道,以及显示我们管道的实验结果,对苯基典型测量的迅速坚持率最高。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The plant orbiter pipeline, showing both the reconstruction and text-to-3D setups. In step 1, we acquire an appropriate input image of a plant, either a single photograph or the output of a high-quality 2D diffusion model. Step 2 and 3 show how a pretrained LoRA model is used in conjunction with MiniMax H3 to generate a 73 (figure shows 12 for simplicity) frame video with each frame at a predetermined position, forming an orbit around the photographed plant. Finally in step 4 we reconstruct the plant from the video using 3D Gaussian splatting, using the knowledge of the camera placements to both determine camera positions during initialisation, and to align the output plant to the input images frame.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 工厂轨道器管道,显示重建和文本至3D的设置。 在步骤1中,我们获得一个植物的适当输入图像,要么是单一的照片,要么是高质量二维扩散模型的输出. 第2步和第3步显示如何与MiniMax H3结合使用预先训练的LORA模型生成73(图显示12为简洁)帧视频,每个帧在一个预定位置,形成环绕被拍摄工厂的轨道. 最后在第4步中,我们用三维高斯电镀来重建从视频中生成的电厂,利用相机布置的知识,在初始化过程中确定相机位置,并使输出电厂与输入图像框架对齐.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 3D plant reconstruction. 3D plant reconstruction makes it possible to capture detailed, precise plant morphology traits and supports automated, high-throughput crop phenotyping [ 32 ] . 3D plants models have traditionally been obtained with laser scanning [ 35 ] , structured light or RGB-D sensors [ 9 ] , or from many overlapping photographs using structure-from-motion and multi-view stereo [ 68 ] . These approaches can be highly accurate, but they need dedicated equipment, controlled conditions and many viewpoints per plant. Plant structure also makes them fragile; thin leaves, overlapping organs and self-occlusion result in gaps and distortions in the reconstruction [ 32 , 46 ] .
blocks.zh: 3D植物重建. 3个 D植物重建使得能够捕捉到详细,精确的植物形态特征,并支持自动化,高通量的作物麻黄[32]. 3D植物模型传统上是用激光扫描[35],结构光或RGB-D传感器[9]获得的,或者从许多使用结构自动和多视立体的重叠照片中获得的[68]. 这些方法可以高度精确,但它们需要专用设备,控制条件和每个工厂的许多观点. 植物结构也使它们变得脆弱;细叶,器官重叠和自我隔离导致重建中的空白和扭曲[32,46].

blocks.en: Neural radiance fields (NeRF) [ 44 ] and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) [ 27 ] have since substantially raised the fidelity of plant reconstruction from ordinary photographs. While NeRF variants successfully model complex appearance without depth supervision, their implicit representation makes it hard to extract the explicit surfaces needed for trait measurement [ 5 , 54 ] . 3DGS instead models the scene with explicit Gaussian primitives, which train quickly and render in real time, recovering traits such as plant height and leaf dimensions with accuracy close to laser scanning [ 58 , 41 , 75 ] . Robotic capture systems extend them to occluded organs and growth tracking [ 3 , 4 ] . However, these gains in fidelity have not reduced the cost of acquisition, as current methods still require tens to hundreds of calibrated photographs of each plant.
blocks.zh: 神经辐射场(NERF)[44]和3D高斯电镀(3DGS)[27]从此从普通照片中大大提高了植物重建的忠诚度. 虽然NERF变体在没有深度监督的情况下成功模拟了复杂的外观,但其隐含的表示使得难以提取特征测量所需的显性表面[5,54]. 3DGS转而以明显的高斯原始物来模拟该场景,这些原始物快速训练并实时渲染,以接近激光扫描的精度恢复植物高度和叶片尺寸等特征[58,41,75]. 机器人捕捉系统将其扩展至吞噬器官和生长跟踪[3,4]. 然而,这些忠于职守的收益并没有降低购置成本,因为目前的方法仍然需要对每个工厂进行数十到数百次校准的照片.

blocks.en: 3D generation from images and text. Generative 3D models learn shape and appearance from 3D training data that let them produce a complete object, including its unseen sides, from a single image or a text prompt. Because 3D training datasets are far scarcer than image-text pairs, early text-to-3D methods optimised a 3D representation for each prompt by distilling a pretrained 2D diffusion model through score distillation sampling (SDS) [ 48 ] . GaussianDreamer [ 77 ] applies SDS to 3D Gaussians for speed. MVDream [ 56 ] distils from a camera-conditioned multi-view diffusion model, which reduces the multi-face artefacts that arise when each view is supervised independently. In parallel, image-conditioned methods learned to synthesise novel views from one image [ 37 , 55 , 38 , 40 ] and then lifted them to 3D in a single forward pass [ 22 , 62 , 71 ] . TRELLIS [ 70 ] decodes structured sparse-voxel latents into Gaussians or meshes from an image or a prompt, and TRELLIS.2 [ 69 ] extends this to open and non-manifold surfaces. Hunyuan3D 2.1 [ 25 ] first generates the shape with a diffusion transformer and then textures it in a separate stage, and DiffSplat [ 34 ] repurposes an image diffusion model to generate Gaussian splats.
blocks.zh: 从图像和文本生成 3D 。 generative 3D模型从3D训练数据中学习形状和外观,使其从单一的图像或文本提示中产生一个完整的对象,包括其看不见的侧面. 由于3D训练数据集远比图像文本配对更稀少,早期的文本到3D方法通过分数蒸馏(SDS)[48],通过分数蒸馏法提取预训的2D扩散模型,优化了每个提示的3D表示. GaussianDreamer [77] 将SDS应用于3D高斯人的速度. MVDream [56] 从一个相机条件的多视图传播模型中提取,这减少了每个视图独立监督时产生的多面手工艺品. 同时,从一个图像[37,55,38,40]中学习到的以图像为条件的方法合成新颖观点,然后在一次前传中将其提升为3D[22,62,71]. TRELLIS [70] 解码结构化的稀有伏克斯尔潜伏物从一个图像或一个即时分解成高斯人或中间体,TRELLIS.2 [69] 将其延伸至开放的和非狂翻的表面. Hunyuan3D 2.1 [25] 先用扩散变压器生成形状,然后在单独的阶段进行纹理,DiffSplact [34] 重新使用图像扩散模型生成高斯板.

blocks.en:
Multi-view image models generate only a handful of views, whereas video diffusion models, trained on vast real-world footage, learn how objects transform under continuous camera motion and can synthesise dense novel-view trajectories [ 7 ] .
SV3D [ 65 ] and V3D [ 8 ] fine-tune Stable Video Diffusion on rendered 360° orbits of synthetic objects, so that a single image yields a full orbit at known camera angles, to which a NeRF or Gaussian splat is then fitted. Later work improves the resolution and consistency of these orbits [ 74 , 82 , 42 , 66 ] , and SEVA [ 81 ] extends them to arbitrary camera trajectories from one or more input views.
Camera control can also be added to general-purpose video generators, either by injecting camera poses [ 67 , 20 ] or by training lightweight LoRAs for specific camera motions [ 60 ] .
VIST3A [ 16 ] skips explicit frames and decodes scene-level 3D Gaussians directly from the latents of a text-to-video model.
blocks.zh:
多视图图像模型只产生少量的视图,而视频传播模型则在广袤的现实世界镜头上训练,学习物体如何在连续镜头运动下变形,并能合成密集的小说-视图轨迹[7].
SV3D [65]和V3D [8]在合成物体的360°轨道上微调稳定视频散射,这样一幅图像就可以在已知的相机角度产生完整的轨道,然后安装一个NERF或高斯板. 后来的工作提高了这些轨道的分辨率和一致性[74,82,42,66],SEVA[81]将其延伸至一个或多个输入视图的任意相机轨迹.
相机控制还可以通过注射相机姿势[67,20]或者通过训练轻量级的LORA来进行特定的相机运动[60]来添加到通用视频发电机中.
VIST3A [16] 跳过清晰的帧,直接从文本到视频模型的潜伏中解码场景级别3D高斯人.

blocks.en: These models are trained mainly on synthetic 3D assets [ 12 ] and evaluated on general objects, and plants, with their thin, overlapping and highly variable organs, expose the limits of this training [ 17 , 14 ] . Single-image methods built for plants do exist, but they mostly target trees and rely on hand-designed botanical priors [ 31 , 33 , 30 , 39 ] . From text, general 3D generators also offer little control over specific plant traits, such as the number of fruit, whereas text-to-image models, trained on far more data, follow such detailed prompts much more closely [ 79 ] . Our aim is therefore to generate 3D plants that are faithful to an input image or text prompt, leveraging the priors of existing text-to-image and video diffusion models without requiring specialised 3D plant training data.
blocks.zh: 这些模型主要接受合成立体资产[12]的培训,并接受一般物体的评价,植物的器官细小、重叠和多变,暴露了这种训练的限度[17、14]。 为植物建造的单图象方法确实存在,但它们大多以树木为目标,并依赖于人工设计的植物学前科[31,33,30,39]. 从文字来看,一般的3D生成器也很少能控制特定的植物特征,例如水果的数量,而文字到图像模型则经过更多数据的培训,更紧密地遵循这种详细的提示[79]. 因此,我们的目标是生成忠于输入图像或文本提示的3D厂房,利用现有文本到图像和视频传播模型的前身,而不需要专门的3D厂房培训数据。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Single Image Orbital Video
blocks.zh: 3.1 单一图像轨道视频

blocks.en: Our method leverages the strong understanding of 3D shape that has been learned by powerful video diffusion models. We use Minimax H3 [ 45 ] along with a LoRA trained to produce orbital camera videos around the plant [ 11 ] . For each video the model is prompted with a single image of the front side of a given plant. We preprocess each image to remove all background elements using provided masks or SAM 2.1 [ 52 ] where masks are not provided. We then undistort the image, add it to a white canvas, and resize it to fit Minimax’s native 768 × 768 768\times 768 resolution. The input image is given the Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) [ 59 ] position for the first and last frame in the sequence, ensuring the camera arc returns perfectly to the original location in the loop. Additionally, the model receives the text prompt used to train the original LoRA, conditioning the model to produce a consistent, level camera arc around the object while keeping the plant still to discourage motion that would otherwise reduce the model quality and enforce a static scene.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法利用了对3D形状的强烈理解,而这种理解是通过强大的视频传播模型学到的. 我们使用Minimax H3 [45] 与一个LORA训练, 生产轨道摄像头视频 在工厂周围 [11]。 对于每个视频,模型都以特定植物前方的单一图像来激发. 我们预处理每个图像,以删除所有背景元素,使用所提供的口罩或SAM 2.1[52],而没有提供口罩。 并调整大小, 以适应Minimax本地的768×768768/Times 768分辨率。 输入的图像被赋予了顺序中第一个和最后一个帧的旋转位置嵌入(ROPE)[59]位置,确保相机弧完全返回回环中原来的位置. 此外,该模型还接收了用于训练原始LORA的文字提示,对模型进行调制,以产生一个一致的,水平的相机弧绕物体,同时使工厂保持不动,否则会降低模型质量并强制执行静态场景.

blocks.en: 3.2 Known Pose Camera Recovery
blocks.zh: 3.2 已知的Pose相机回收

blocks.en: Generally, the first stage of 3DGS pipelines is the extraction of camera positions using COLMAP [ 53 ] , using structure from motion to correctly identify the cameras position and rotation within the scene. For 3D plant reconstruction, this method struggles to extract features on the repetitive, detailed structures of the plant surfaces, as well as being computationally expensive. Instead we exploit the consistent, known parameters of the orbital video to skip this stage of reconstruction, and use easily calculated camera poses based on a known camera path. With 73 frames including the duplicated frame for 0 and 72, each frame represents a uniformly spaced 5 degree increment in the orbit around the plant starting from an initial pose 1 arbitrary unit from the rotational axis. The camera’s path maintains a fixed distance and directed at this centre axis, which the video diffusion model takes to be the object at the horizontal midpoint of the frame.
blocks.zh: 一般而言,3DGS管道的第一阶段是使用COLMAP[53]提取摄像头位置,使用从运动的结构来正确识别摄像头位置和场内旋转. 对于3D植物重建,这种方法在植物表面的重复性,详细结构上挣扎着提取特征,并且计算成本也很高. 相反,我们利用轨道视频的一致、已知参数来跳过这一重建阶段,并使用基于已知的相机路径的易于计算的相机姿势。 73帧,包括0和72的重复帧,每个帧代表工厂周围轨道上统一间距的5度增量,从初始形成自旋转轴产生的1个任意单元开始. 相机的路径保持固定的距离,并瞄准这个中轴线,视频传播模型认为这个中轴线是帧的横向中点的对象.

blocks.en: For effective training, 3D Gaussians are conventionally initialised from an initial point cloud generated from the structure-from-motion process employed to extract the camera poses. However, as COLMAP is skipped, we replace its initial Gaussians with ones we compute from a visual hull of the plant, ensuring high-quality 3D reconstruction. Each video frame is used to carve a silhouette cone [ 29 ] from a voxel grid, with each surviving voxel used as an initial Gaussian [ 73 , 8 ] . As the video model does not output its focal length or elevation, we also calculate an estimate of these values during this process by determining the values that cause the projected carved hull to intersect most accurately with the plant masks across all viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 为了有效培训,3D高斯人通常从从用来提取相机姿势的结构自动过程产生的初始点云中消失。 然而,由于COLMAP被跳过,我们用我们从工厂的视觉船体中计算出来的高斯人来取代它,确保高质量的3D重建. 每个视频框都用于从一个voxel网格中刻出一个圆锥[29],每个幸存的voxel作为初始高斯琴[73,8]. 由于视频模型没有输出其焦距或高程,我们还通过确定导致所预测的木雕船体与工厂遮罩最准确地交叉的数值,计算出在这一过程中这些值的估计数。

blocks.en: 3.3 3D Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.3 三维重建

blocks.en: Training each Gaussian splat is performed using NerfStudio’s [ 61 ] Splatfacto [ 27 , 76 ] model with default parameters, apart from enabling antialiased rasterisation and scale regularisation (with maximum Gaussian axis ratio of 3) to remove long, needle like Gaussians. We perform masked training so that only the plant is reconstructed, and the 3D model is trained for 30,000 iterations, which is standard practice for 3DGS reconstruction. For each plant, we also produce a matching 2D Gaussian Splat (2DGS) [ 23 ] model, which replaces the 3D gaussians with flat 2D disks and is trained with additional depth-normal consistency and depth distortion losses. Because of this 2DGS models produce more surface-aligned reconstructions compared to the original 3DGS implementation, allowing for a mesh to be extracted with truncated signed distance function (TSDF) [ 10 ] after training which we then use for our 3D geometric evaluation.
blocks.zh: 训练每个高斯底板都使用NerfStudio的[61] Splatfacto [27,76] 模型进行,带有默认参数,除此之外,还允许抗异形光栅化和规模调节(最大高斯底轴比为3)去除像高斯底那样长的针头. 我们进行蒙面训练,以便只重建工厂,3D模型则训练3万迭代,这是3DGS重建的标准做法. 对于每个工厂,我们也生产匹配的2D Gaussian Splate(2DGS)[23]型号,该型号以平面2D磁盘取代3D Gaussian,并经过额外深度-正常一致性和深度扭曲损失的训练. 由于这种2DGS模型,与最初的3DGS执行相比,可以产生更多的表面对齐的重建,使得一个网格在经过训练后可以使用截断的签名距离函数(TSDF)[10]进行提取,然后用于我们的3D几何评价.

blocks.en: 3.4 Alignment
blocks.zh: 3.4 对齐

blocks.en: In order to accurately evaluate the 3D plant reconstructions, alignment between generated models and the ground truth must first be established. All 3D reconstruction models return the plant within their own arbitrary canonical frame, which require a transform (scale, rotation, and translation) to bring them into the frame of the real cameras for evaluation. This reflects real world usage where the ability to accurately phenotype from a reconstruction relies on it being correctly scaled and positioned within its frame; however precise realignment is a known challenge [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了准确评价3D厂房重建,首先必须确定生成的模型与地面真相之间的一致. 所有3D重建模型都会在自己的任意犬形框架内返回工厂,这需要变换(尺度,旋转,和翻译),将工厂带入真相机的框架以供评价. 这反映了真实世界的用法,即从重建中准确使用苯型的能力取决于在重建框架内正确进行规模调整和定位;无论如何精确的调整是一项已知的挑战[14]。

blocks.en: To precisely position reconstructed plants within the real scene, a known real world measure is required to determine the scale of the reconstructed object. In a capture environment designed with this in mind, an object of known dimensions can be used as a reference. As a reference is not provided in each dataset we use, we instead calculate the real world scale of each plant from the plant’s distance from the input camera, which we derived from each dataset’s calibrated camera pose data. We then scale each reconstructed object such that the orbit radius matches this distance, adjusting for different focal lengths. After scaling, each reconstruction must be orientated and positioned to match the position of the ground truth. For Plant Orbiter, we initialise this process by aligning the first orbit camera to the input image’s camera. Afterwards, we fit the reconstruction’s silhouette to the plant mask as seen from the input image (or for oracle placement, all held out view) over 300 steps using an Adam Optimiser. This gives a similarity correction using uniform scale, 3D rotation and translation which provides our final alignment.
blocks.zh: 要精确地把重建的植物置于真实的场景中,需要一种已知的真实的世界度量来确定重建对象的规模. 在以此为思想设计的捕捉环境中,已知维度的对象可以用作参考. 由于我们使用的每一个数据集都没有提供参考,我们而是从工厂与输入相机的距离计算出每个工厂的实际世界尺度,我们从每个数据集的校准相机中得出这些数据。 然后,我们把每个重建的物体放大,使轨道半径与这个距离相匹配,并调整不同的焦距。 规模扩大后,每次重建都必须有方向,定位要与地面真相的位置相匹配. 对 Plant Orbiter 来说, 我们通过将第一个轨道相机与输入图像相机对齐来实现此进程 。 之后,我们用亚当·奥普西泽(Adam Optimiser)的图像(或用于甲骨文放置, 全部为外观)将重建的遮罩贴在工厂的面具上。 这给出了相似性的校正,使用统一的尺度,三维旋转和翻译,提供了我们的最终校正.

blocks.en: For the 3D generator baselines evaluated against in this paper we cannot rely on a known start position or radius, since these models produce a 3D reconstruction in an unknown canonical frame depending on the plant and generator. Instead we perform scaling by matching the reconstructed plant’s height against the pixel height in the input image. Then to normalise each reconstruction, we orient the plant upright using the generators default up axis, or using its longest axis with its pot as the base where this method fails. We then iterate over 10° yaw increments over 0.8, 1.0 and 1.25 scales and rank for silhouette IoU against the alignment view(s). We double the number of steps taken during correction to maximise the precision of the final alignment, ensuring a fair comparison between plant reconstructions.
blocks.zh: 对于本文中对照的3D生成器基线,我们不能依赖已知的起始位置或半径,因为这些模型根据工厂和生成器的不同,在未知的峡谷框架内产生3D重建. 相反,我们通过将重建的工厂的高度与输入图像中的像素高度相匹配来实现缩放。 然后,为了使每个重建正常化,我们用发电机默认向上轴线,或者用其最长的轴线,用它的锅作为这种方法失败的基地。 然后,我们比对对对准视图,将0.8、1.0和1.25比方升至10度以上,并排位。 我们把改正过程中为尽可能精确地进行最后调整所采取的步骤增加一倍,确保植物重建之间的公平比较。

blocks.en: To match a real world scenario where only a single image is captured, we compute this similarity against only the single image used to generate the 3D model (experiments labelled input view placement ), however we also complete a second evaluation round aligning against all held out views (experiments labelled oracle ), to determine true accuracy score assuming an upper bound alignment.
blocks.zh: 为了匹配真实世界中只捕捉到单一图像的情景,我们只计算出用于生成3D模型的单一图像(实验标签输入视图放置)的这种相似性,然而,我们也完成了第二轮评估,对所有持有的视图(实验标签甲骨文)进行对齐,以确定假设上限对齐的真实准确分数.

blocks.en: 3.5 Text-to-3D generation
blocks.zh: 3.5 文本到3D生成

blocks.en: Since Plant Orbiter needs only a single image, it can be turned into a text-to-3D generator by first generating a synthetic image from a text prompt using a text-to-image model, and then lifting it to 3D with the pipeline described earlier. This approach inherits the strong prompt adherence of standard 2D text-to-image models, which are trained on far more data than is available in 3D datasets, allowing fine-grained attributes such as the number of fruit to be specified in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 自从植物 轨道器只需要一个单一的图像,通过首先使用文本到图像模型从文本提示生成合成图像,然后用前面描述的管道将其提升到3D,就可以变成文本到3D生成器. 这种方法继承了标准2D文本对映模型的强烈的即时遵守,这些模型在3D数据集所具备的数据上接受的训练远多于3D数据集,从而可以在即时指定果实数量等精细的属性.

blocks.en: We use Qwen-Image-2.1 [ 50 ] with default parameters to generate 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 pixel input images. To ensure the generated image matches the input expected by the orbital video model, we append a fixed framing suffix to the content prompt. For example, the prompt for bean becomes “A photo of bean plants. Single potted plant, whole plant and pot fully in frame and centred with margin around it, eye-level side view, isolated on a plain white background, studio lighting.” The suffix is identical for every plant species generated, and adds only framing, background and lighting terms, so the plant description itself is the same prompt that every baseline receives.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 Quen-Image-2.1 [50] 有默认参数生成 2048× 2048\times 2048 像素输入图像. 为确保生成的图像与轨道视频模型预期的输入匹配,我们在内容提示中附加一个固定的框后缀. 例如,对豆的催化变为“豆类植物的照片”。 单一的盆栽、整个盆栽和盆栽完全装在框内,并围绕其以边角为中心,眼平面侧视,在纯白色背景上隔离,工作室照明。” 后缀对每个生成的植物物种都是一样的,只添加了框架,背景和照明术语,因此植物描述本身就是每个基线收到的相同的提示.

blocks.en: 4 Single-Image Reconstruction Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 单图像重建实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: For our experiments, we evaluate over a range of different multi-view plant datasets captured using a combination of cameras mounted on robot arms, turntables, bespoke multi-camera capture environments and handheld capture. For each plant we select one real photo showing the entire plant, which is then used as the input for all single view reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 对我们的实验来说,我们评价了使用安装在机器人臂上的摄像机组合捕获的一系列不同的多视点植物数据集、转盘、声控多相机捕获环境和手持式捕获。 对于每个工厂,我们选择一个真实的照片 显示整个工厂, 然后作为所有单一视图重建的输入。

blocks.en: The PlantDreamer [ 17 ] dataset constitutes the primary dataset we evaluated, containing multi-view captures of bean, mint and kale plants captured using two Universal Robots UR5 robotic arms. The overall dataset contains 21 individual plants, including 12 instances of bean plants, 6 instances of mint and 3 instances of kale. For our experiments, we omit a single instance of bean due to incorrect mask data included in the published dataset. Each plant is captured with approximately 220 views at a range of elevations, and 27 images were included in the evaluation dataset for assessing the photometric quality of the reconstruction. For a fair comparison, these evaluation images were solely used as the reference images in the single-image generation models. PlantDreamer does not come with a true 3D ground truth and instead provides point clouds derived from 3D Gaussian splats [ 1 ] , which are produced using the images provided which we use as a 3D reference during experimentation. During experimentation we observed that the masks provided with PlantDreamer were poorly cropped to the plant, resulting in poor performence, so applied an intersection between the provided masks and IS-Net [ 49 ] for all experiments to improve the segmentation.
blocks.zh: PlantDreamer [17] 数据集构成我们评价的主要数据集,包含用两个通用机器人UR5机器人臂捕获的豆,薄荷和甘蓝植物的多视图捕获. 总体数据集包含21种单株植物,包括12种豆类植物,6种薄荷和3种甘蓝. 对于我们的实验,我们省略了单一的豆例,因为公布的数据集包含的面具数据不正确. 每个工厂在一系列高地上都有大约220个观测点,评价数据集中有27幅图像用于评估重建的光度质量。 为了进行公平的比较,这些评价图像完全被用作单图生成模型中的参考图像. PlantDreamer并没有带一个真实的3D地面真理,而是提供来自3D高斯板[1]的点云,这些点云是在实验时使用我们用作3D参考的图像产生的. 在实验中,我们观察到,用PlantDreamer提供的口罩对工厂的耕作不良,导致工作表现不佳,因此在所提供的口罩与IS-Net[49]之间应用了一个交叉点,用于所有实验,以改善分化。

blocks.en: The Berkeley Botany-Bot [ 3 ] dataset contains 8 different houseplants and was captured by placing the plant on a turntable, acquiring images at four elevations. Each plant has 91-96 total views, and we evaluate using all held-out samples for each experiment. Botany-Bot neither provides a 3D ground truth nor an appropriate 3D reference, so instead we generate our own 2DGS from the real photos provided as a 3D reference.
blocks.zh: 伯克利植物-植物[3]数据集包含8个不同的家用植物,通过将植物放在一个转盘上,在四高处获取图像来捕捉. 每个工厂都有91-96的总视点, 我们利用所有被搁置的样本来评估每个实验。 植物-植物既不提供3D地面的真假,也不提供合适的3D参考,因此我们从作为3D参考提供的真实照片中生成自己的2DGS.

blocks.en: The PLANesT-3D [ 43 ] dataset contains 10 instances of potted pepper and rose plants, each captured manually using a handheld DSLR camera. These plants were captured from 180-400 viewpoints and evaluated using 64 evenly spaced evaluation views taken from the unused images. We exclude a single pepper instance during 3D evaluation because its point cloud data could not be aligned to its photos, suggesting movement during capture. For 3D, PLANesT provides labelled Metashape point clouds which are registered to the cameras by a silhouette fit.
blocks.zh: PlanesT-3D [43] 数据集包含10个盆状胡椒和玫瑰植物实例,每个案例使用手持DSLR相机人工捕获. 这些工厂是从180-400角度采集的,并使用从未使用的图像中提取的64个平面评价视图进行了评估。 在3D评价时,我们排除了单一的胡椒实例,因为其点云数据无法与其照片对齐,说明捕获过程中的运动. 对于3D, 计划 T提供贴有标签的Metashape点云,这些点云是用一个适合的圆筒登记在摄像机上的。

blocks.en: The GrowSplat [ 4 ] dataset, by contrast to the previous methods, is a time series dataset showing a quinoa and a sequoia plant each growing over 17 time steps. For the purposes of our experiments, we remove the earliest time step for quinoa, as the plant at that stage was too small to be reconstructed by any of the methods evaluated in this paper. The images were captured using an imaging box that contained fixed cameras at five positions around the plant, at three fixed heights, resulting in a total of 15 views per plant. We evaluate over all 14 unused held out images during our evaluations. Each plant in GrowSplat also provides a metric plant point cloud using an accurate LiDAR scanner, which we use as a height reference for our downstream evaluations.
blocks.zh: GrowSplat [4]数据集与之前的方法形成对比,是一个时间序列数据集,显示一个quinoa和一个sequoia植物在17个时间步长. 为了我们的实验目的,我们取消了昆诺阿最早的时间步骤,因为那个阶段的工厂太小,无法用本文评估的任何方法重建. 利用一个装有固定摄像头的成像盒在工厂周围的5个位置,在3个固定高度拍摄图像,每个工厂总共15次观看。 我们评价了所有14个未使用的照片。 GrowSplat的每个工厂还使用精确的LiDAR扫描仪提供一个测量的植物点云,我们用它作为下游评价的高度参考.

blocks.en: For all datasets the background was digitally removed, using either provided masks to isolate the plant and pot from the background, or our own masks generated with a SAM 2.1 [ 52 ] segmentation pipeline. This was done to cleanly produce a Gaussian splat of the target plant and remove background artifacts in the orbit video that did not consistently rotate with the plant.
blocks.zh: 对所有数据集来说,背景是数字化的,要么是使用提供面具将工厂和锅与背景隔离开来,要么是用SAM 2.1[52]分块管产生的我们自己的面具。 这样做是为了清洁地生产一个目标植物的高斯海板,并清除轨道视频中与该植物不连贯旋转的背景文物.

blocks.en: 4.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线

blocks.en: To evaluate our method we select a number of SotA monocular 3D reconstruction methods to compare against. We include TRELLIS [ 70 ] , TRELLIS.2 [ 69 ] , and Hunyuan3D 2.1 [ 25 ] (the most recent version available for local use), as these are currently the highest performing available models that could be employed as part of a 3D phenotyping pipeline, and have seen interest in previous phenotyping works for single-image reconstruction [ 14 ] . TRELLIS produces its own Gaussians and a mesh for 3D scoring, while both TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D 2.1 produce textured meshes which we convert into Gaussians for rendering, and are run using default settings as described in their documentation. Each method receives the same input image having undergone the same preprocessing steps as Plant Orbiter. We opt to give each baseline our own cropped image, rather than relying on built in background removal, as we found poorer performance at this stage unfairly penalised these models relative to our own.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的方法,我们选择了一些SotA单体3D重建方法来比较. 我们包括TRELLIS [70],TRELLIS 2 [69],和Hunyuan3D 2.1 [25](最新版本可供当地使用),因为这些模型是目前作为3D型螺旋管的一部分可以使用的性能最高的现有模型,并且对以前的单一图像重建的螺旋管工程产生了兴趣[14]. TRELLIS生产它自己的高斯琴和一个用于3D评分的网格,而TRELLIS.2和Hunyuan3D 2.1都生产我们转换成高斯琴用于渲染的纹理网格,并且使用它们文档中描述的默认设置运行. 每种方法都得到与Plant Orbiter相同的输入图像,经过同样的预处理步骤. 我们选择给每个基线提供我们自己所塑造的图像,而不是依靠在清除背景时所构建的图像,因为我们认为,在现阶段,这些模型的性能较差,比我们自己的模型受到不公正的惩罚。

blocks.en: We additionally test against SEVA [ 81 ] and SV3D [ 65 ] , two other methods that use video diffusion for 3D reconstruction. SEVA is a multi-view diffusion model that we configure to generate 72 views around the object, matching our setup, while SV3D is a video diffusion pipeline, from which we configured to generate 21 frames around the plant at 10° of elevation. As neither of these models natively generate a 3D reconstruction, we append our downstream pipeline, including use of known poses, as well as splatting and meshing pipelines to produce the outputs used in our evaluation. As such, this test primarily evaluates the accuracy of the orbital LoRA compared to standard video diffusion approaches.
blocks.zh: 我们额外测试SEVA[81]和SV3D[65],另外两种方法使用视频传播进行3D重建. SEVA是一个多视图传播模型,我们配置它以生成围绕对象的72个视图,匹配我们的设置,而SV3D是一个视频传播管道,我们从中配置到在10°高的工厂周围生成21帧. 由于这两个模型都不是本地产生的三维重建,我们附带我们的下游管道,包括使用已知的布局,以及电镀和电锯管道,以产生我们评价中使用的产出。 因此,与标准视频传播方法相比,这项测试主要评价轨道LORA的准确性。

blocks.en: To fairly evaluate the baseline outputs, proper alignment between the 3D plant models was needed. Reconstruction models generally produce output in their own canonical frame, and reorienting and scaling them is a known challenge [ 14 ] . A core advantage of video diffusion method is the implicit alignment with the input image that is automatically achieved, while baseline methods were aligned by matching the reconstructions silhouette against the 2D mask. Full details on alignment are found in section 3.4 . Finally, to improve reliability of our results, all experiments on reconstruction quality in sections 4.4 and 4.5 were carried out using three different seeds.
blocks.zh: 为了公平地评价基线产出,三维工厂模型之间需要适当调整。 重建模式一般在自己的峡谷框架内产生产出,重新定位和规模化是已知的挑战[14]. 视频传播方法的一个核心优势是暗中与自动实现的输入图像对齐,而基线方法则通过将重建的silhouette与2D遮罩对齐来对齐. 关于对齐的全部细节见一节。 3.4 (英语). 最后,为了提高我们结果的可靠性,第4.4节和第4.5节中关于重建质量的所有试验都是用三种不同的种子进行的。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价计量

blocks.en: We perform evaluation across three sets of experiments shown in tables 1 , 2 , and 3 , using metrics defined below.
blocks.zh: 我们对表1、表2和表3所示的三套实验进行评价,使用以下界定的衡量标准。

blocks.en: 2D evaluation is performed using a range of metrics which directly compare renders of the reconstruction against ground truth held out images of the same camera pose. We use four metrics: IoU (the overlap between the render and ground truth silhouettes divided by their union), PSNR (the pixelwise error between the render and ground truth), LPIPS [ 78 ] (deep feature distance between the render and ground truth image), and DISTS [ 13 ] (comparison of structure and texture between render and ground truth, included for being more tolerant to small misalignments). For fairness, especially with pixel error metrics, we apply colour correction to the renders of each method’s output using a transform fitted to each input image.
blocks.zh: 使用一系列的衡量标准进行二维评价,这些衡量标准直接比较了重建与同一摄像机所显示的地面真实情况。 我们使用四个度量衡:IoU(渲染和地面真象的重叠因结合而分裂),PSNR(渲染和地面真象之间的像素误差),LPIPS[78](渲染和地面真象之间的深度特征距离),和DISTS[13](渲染和地面真象之间的结构和纹理比较,包括因为对小的错象更宽容). 为了公平起见,特别是在像素误差计量标准方面,我们使用与每个输入图像相适应的变换,对每种方法输出的成份进行颜色校正。

blocks.en: While 2D IoU already gives some indication of 3D structural accuracy, we also include 3D evaluation where we compare the aligned 3D reconstruction against a ground truth or derived 3D representation from each full dataset. For this we use Chamfer Distance (the average distance between each point on the reconstruction to the nearest point on the ground truth, and again from the ground truth to the reconstruction both averaged, normalised to the reference bounding box and shown as × 10 3 \times 10^{3} ) and F-score (the harmonic mean of the fraction of points in the reconstruction within τ \tau of the reference and vice versa, where τ \tau is 1% of the reference bounding box diagonal).
blocks.zh: 虽然2D IoU已经给出了一些三维结构精度的表示,但我们也包括了三维评价,在这种评价中,我们将对齐的三维重建与地面的真理进行比较,或者从每个完整的数据集中得出三维表示. 为此,我们使用Chamfer距离(重建中每一点与地面真相最接近点之间的平均距离,以及从地面真相再次从地面真相到重建的平均距离),两者均是平均的,与参照框一致并显示为x 10 3\time 10\time 3})和F-score(参照框内重建中各点的调谐平均值,反之亦然,其中\ tau是参照框对角的1%)。

blocks.en: 4.4 Single Image Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 单一图像重建

blocks.en: Results in Table 1 demonstrate that for the input-view case, we score best for shape measures for PlantDreamer (0.552 vs 0.529) and Botany-Bot (0.556 vs 0.504) and score second on the PLANesT (0.343 vs 0.348). For DISTS measurements of perceptual similarity, we score best across all datasets, while for pixel metrics PSNR and LPIPS we are among the top three best performing models. Visualisations of all models results for all datasets can be seen in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 表1的结果显示,对于输入视图案例,我们对PlanteDreamer(0.552 vs 0.529)和植物-植物(0.556 vs 0.504)的形状测量得分最佳,在PlanesT(0.343 vs 0.348)上得分第二。 对于感知相似性的DISTS测量,我们在所有数据集中得分最高,而对于像素度量度量度量度量度量度量度度度度度度度值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值 所有数据集所有模型结果的可视化可以在图2中看到.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows separate results for input-view placement and oracle placement. These results show substantial performance improvements are gained by all models through more accurate placement, and notably that the improvement of the TRELLIS and Hunyuan3D models was larger than those of our method, with TRELLIS.2 now leading in some metrics having received the largest improvement due to alignment. By contrast, Plant Orbiter continues to lead Botany-Bot across all four metrics, as well leading in IoU for PLANesT. This shows that placement from a single frame is unreliable for the generator baselines, whereas our method is much stronger in input-view placement due to orientation being known by construction. We find that the oracle placements for the generator models have median 16° (TRELLIS.2), 27° (TRELLIS) and 48° (Hunyuan3D) difference between input placement and oracle placement, demonstrating that single image alignment is repeatedly insufficient to align the outputs of these models.
blocks.zh: 表1显示输入视图放置和甲骨文放置的单独结果。 这些结果显示,所有模型都通过更精确的投放获得了显著的性能改进,显著的是TRELLIS和Hunyuan3D模型的改进比我们的方法大,配有TRELLIS. 2 在一些衡量标准方面,由于调整,目前取得了最大的改进。 相比之下,Plant Orbiter继续带领植物学-Bot贯穿所有四个度量,同时也在IoU中领先于PlanesT. 这表明,单帧投放对发电机基线来说是不可靠的,而我们的方法在输入视图投放方面则要强得多,因为施工中已知方向。 我们发现,发电机模型的甲骨文放置有中间值16°(TRELLIS.2),27°(TRELLIS)和48°(Hunyuan3D)的输入放置和甲骨文放置的区别,表明单个图像对齐反复不足以使这些模型的输出对齐.

blocks.en: The input-view alignment best reflects the real world situation where an agronomist would want to take measurements using a single hand-captured image, and it is in this setting that our method performs best. We also observe that even with Oracle placement, our method still achieved the second highest score for PlantDreamer, and the highest score for Botany-Bot and PLANesT, despite the latter being the most challenging dataset. This shows that our methods advantage is not from alignment alone, but also matches or exceeds the strongest generator on shape, and we argue geometric measures are the most important for downstream phenotyping which is supported further in section 4.5 .
blocks.zh: 输入-视图的对齐最能反映一个农学家希望用单一的手抓图像进行测量的现实世界状况,正是在这个背景下,我们的方法表现最好。 我们还观察到,即使有了甲骨文的放置,我们的方法仍然取得了PlantDreamer的第二高分,也是植物学-Bot和PlanesT的最高分,尽管后者是最具挑战性的数据集. 这表明,我们的方法优势不单来自对齐,而且还匹配或超过形状上最强的生成器,我们主张几何测量是下游的最重要的,这一点在第4.5节中得到了进一步支持。

blocks.en: We do observe that while our method performs best in spatial and perceptual metrics (IoU and DISTS respectively), our method is less comparatively strong in pixel similarity metrics such as PSNR, where SV3D is the strongest overall method. Characteristics of pixel similarity metrics mean that fine details with small misalignments are punished more, while lower detail, and blurred geometry is more highly rewarded. We also observe that the absolute PSNR values for all methods are generally poor, likely caused by the invented details on the occluded side of the plant. We believe for these reasons PSNR is less reliable as a signal for the overall quality of reconstruction for these datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们确实观察到,虽然我们的方法在空间和感知度量(分别为IoU和DISTS)方面表现最好,但我们的方法在像素相似度度度度量中,如PSNR(SV3D是其中最强的整体方法)则相对不强. 像素相似度测量的特征意味着带有小错位的精细细节受到更多的惩罚,而较低的细节,模糊的几何学则得到更高的奖励. 我们还注意到,所有方法的绝对PSNR值一般都很差,很可能是植物的圆形一侧发明的细节造成的。 我们认为,由于这些原因,PSNR作为这些数据集重建总体质量的信号不太可靠。

blocks.en: Overall, our results show that our method is the best performing model on shape and perceptual accuracy, with substantial gains over the currently favoured generator models, such as TRELLIS.2, for the real world case of single image generation and alignment. We also show that our method creates the geometrically highest performing reconstructions on most datasets, even in the ideal case of oracle alignment.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的结果表明,我们的方法是形状和感知准确性方面的最佳表现模式,比TRELLIS.2等目前所偏爱的生成器模型,对于单一图像生成和对齐的现实世界来说,有了很大的收益。 我们还表明,我们的方法在大多数数据集上创造了几何最高的性能重建,即使在甲骨文对齐的理想情况下也是如此.

blocks.en: 4.5 3D Geometry
blocks.zh: 4.5 3D 几何

blocks.en: In order to evaluate our output 3D accuracy, we carry out an additional evaluation on Plant Orbiter against the baselines. Since the 3D Gaussian splats produced by our method have no explicit surface, we instead train a 2D Gaussian splat using the same generated orbit video as in our previous approach and extract a mesh from it, giving a surface that can be directly compared against the output from the other baselines. We evaluate over Chamfer distance and F-score to evaluate the true accuracy in 3D of our method and the baselines. Following alignment described in 3.4, we perform an additional normalisation step followed by 200 iterations of the rigid iterative closest point algorithm to properly align the 3D model with the reference point cloud. For PLANesT Dataset, we additionally crop the pot from the 3D model to match the contents of the reference point cloud.
blocks.zh: 为了评价我们产出的3D准确性,我们针对基线对植物轨道器进行了额外的评价。 由于我们的方法所产生的3D高斯板没有明显的表面,我们而是使用我们先前的方法中生成的同样轨道视频来训练一个2D高斯板,并从中提取一个网格,给出一个可以直接与其他基线输出相比的表面. 我们通过Chamfer距离和F分数来评估我们的方法和基线的3D的准确性。 在3.4中描述的对齐之后,我们又进行了一个额外的正常化步骤,然后是200次迭代的刚性迭代最接近点算法,以适当使3D模型与参考点云对齐. 计划 数据集,我们从3D模型中额外裁剪锅,以匹配参考点云的内容.

blocks.en: We report all results in Table 2 with best performing methods highlighted in bold. The results show that our method outperforms all baselines in F-score and has the best Chamfer distance on all but PlantDreamer, where we score slightly worse than TRELLIS.2 (18.3 to 17.7). Within each dataset, we individually beat all baselines on a majority of individual plants, with the clearest wins on Botany-Bot and PLANesT. This highlights how our method excels at generating geometrically consistent plants between frames, which is important for accurate reconstruction and phenotyping.
blocks.zh: 我们在表2中报告所有结果,并以粗体突出显示最佳业绩方法。 结果显示,我们的方法在F分数上超过了所有基线,除PlantDreamer外,在所有的Chamfer距离上都是最好的,我们的得分比TRELLIS.2(18.3至17.7)略差. 在每一个数据集中,我们分别比照大多数单个植物的所有基线,植物-植物和PlanesT最明显地获胜。 这凸显了我们的方法如何在框架之间产生几何一致的植物,这对准确的重建和螺旋化很重要。

blocks.en: 4.6 Downstream Trait Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.6 下游隧道评价

blocks.en: To evaluate our model for representing real downstream plant traits using 3D reconstruction, we select plant height estimation (a common type of spatial phenotyping task) that is well suited for evaluating 3D reconstruction approaches. For these experiments, we use the dataset GrowSplat, a temporal dataset showing two growing plants over a series of 17 time steps. By evaluating the ability of each reconstruction technique to measure the growing height of each plant over many time steps, we seek to verify firstly, to what extent 3D reconstruction methods can be used to measure major phenotypic traits such as height, and additionally to measure the performance of PlantOrbiter with respect to the baselines. We measure each plant from the base of the plant, as taken from the reference, removing the pot and soil prior to measuring. To remove any individual stray Gaussians above the top of the plant, we measure the height by downsampling to one point per 5mm voxel and take the 99.5th percentile of the points above its base.
blocks.zh: 为了利用3D重建来评价我们代表真正下游植物特征的模型,我们选择了非常适合评价3D重建方法的植物高度估计(一种常见的空间圈式任务). 对于这些实验,我们使用数据集GrowSplat,一个时间数据集显示两个生长的植物在一系列的17个时间步骤上. 通过评估每一种重建技术在许多时间步骤中测量每个工厂不断增长的高度的能力,我们力求首先核实在何种程度上可以使用3D重建方法来测量高度等主要线粒体特征,并另外衡量PlantObiter在基线方面的性能。 我们从植物的底部测量每个植物,从参考物中取出,在测量前去除锅和土壤. 为了清除植物顶部以上任何个体的流浪高斯人, 我们通过每5mm voxel 下取样到一个点来测量高度, 取其基部上方的99.5个百分点。

blocks.en: We show numerical results in Table 3 and additional time series data in Fig. 3 . The results show that the performance for downstream evaluation from all three camera-based methods (mean MAPE 3.7 - 5.9%) are much more closely able to estimate the plant heights compared to the generator methods (mean MAPE 12.7 - 15.8%). While both SV3D and SEVA are the best models overall, our method is similarly much more performant in these tasks compared to Hunyuan3D 2.1, the current best generator model. For plant height in particular, our method closely tracks the recorded growth curve, with a slight 6% overestimate of height, while in Fig. 3 we see SEVA has less consistent tracking despite the lower average error. As all three of the best performing model use our reconstruction and camera placement models, we attribute their relatively much higher performance to our pipeline as opposed to the specific video models.
blocks.zh: 我们在表3中显示数字结果,并在图中显示其他时间序列数据。 页:1 结果显示,所有三种相机方法(平均MAPE 3.7-5.9%)的下游评价性能比发电机方法(平均MAPE 12.7-15.8%)更能精确估计工厂高度。 虽然SV3D和SEVA都是总体最好的模型,但是我们的方法在这些任务中的表现与Hunyuan3D 2.1(即目前最好的生成器模型)相似得多. 特别是植物高度,我们的方法 密切跟踪记录的生长曲线, 略高6%的高度估计值, 在Fig。 3,我们看到SEVA虽然平均误差较低,但追踪的一致性却较低. 由于这三种性能最好的模型都使用我们的重建和相机布置模型,我们把它们的性能比特定的视频模型要高得多归结于我们的管道.

blocks.en: 5 Text-to-3D Generation Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 文本到3D生成实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Baselines
blocks.zh: 5.1 基线

blocks.en: We compare our text-to-3D pipeline against SotA text-to-3D methods: GaussianDreamer [ 77 ] , DiffSplat (SD3.5m) [ 34 ] , TRELLIS-text (xlarge) [ 70 ] , and MVDream [ 56 ] . All of them output 3D Gaussian splats except MVDream, which outputs a NeRF (marked † ). Each baseline is run with the default parameters and with the same seed numbers as our method.
blocks.zh: 我们比较我们的文本到3D管道与SotA文本到3D方法:高斯梦器[77],DiffSplate(SD3.5m)[34],TRELLIS-文本(x大)[70],MVDream[56]. 除了MVDream输出一个NERF(标记为 Q)之外,它们都输出3D高斯板. 每个基线都带有默认参数,并且与我们的方法具有相同的种子编号。

blocks.en: Every baseline receives the prompt “A photo of ⟨ \langle species ⟩ \rangle plants. Single potted plant, whole plant.” The first sentence is the guidance prompt of PlantDreamer [ 17 ] , whose real plants serve as our reference set in Section 5.2 , and the second asks every method for a single, complete potted plant, matching more closely to the reference plants against which all methods are scored. Our method receives the same content prompt followed by the framing suffix described in Section 3.5 . PlantDreamer itself is not included as a baseline, since it requires an L-system mesh as input rather than text alone, and it was trained on the same plants that form our reference set.
blocks.zh: 每个基线都收到“X&langle物种X\rangle植物的照片。 单一盆栽,全株。” 第一句是PlantDreamer[17]的指导提示,其真实的植物作为我们在第5.2节中设定的参考物,第二句则询问每一种方法,一个单一的,完整的盆栽植物,更紧密地与所有方法的参照物相匹配. 我们的方法得到了同样的内容,然后是第3.5节所述的框架后缀。 PlantDreamer本身不作为基线列入,因为它需要L-系统网格作为输入,而不只是文本本身,它也是在构成我们参考集的同一植物上训练的.

blocks.en: In the fruit-count experiment (Section 5.3 ) we additionally include TRELLIS.2 [ 69 ] , one of the strongest of the 3D generators evaluated in Section 4 , and give it the same Qwen-Image-2.1 input images as our method. Since both methods then start from an identical image, any difference between them in the fruit count is attributable to the 3D lifting stage alone.
blocks.zh: 在水果计数实验(第5.3节)中,我们增列了TRELLIS.2[69],这是第4节所评价的3D发电机中最强的一台,并给出与我们的方法相同的Quen-Image-2.1输入图像. 由于这两种方法从一个相同的图像开始,它们之间的任何差异都归因于立体提升阶段。

blocks.en: 5.2 Fully synthetic plants
blocks.zh: 5.2 合成植物

blocks.en: We generate bean, kale and mint, the three species of the PlantDreamer dataset (Section 4.1 ), so that the generated plants can be compared with real ones. Each method generates 12 assets per species, with seeds 1–11 and 42, giving 36 assets per method.
blocks.zh: 我们生成豆,甘蓝和薄荷,PlantDreamer数据集的三个物种(第4.1节),这样产生的植物就可以与真正的植物进行比较. 每种方法每个物种产生12项资产,种子1-11和42,每个方法产生36项资产。

blocks.en: Appearance is assessed with three image metrics, each averaged over the 72 views of an asset: the CLIP score [ 51 ] ( 100 × 100\times the cosine similarity between the image and prompt embeddings of OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14); ImageReward [ 72 ] , a learned model of human preference for text-to-image outputs; and the VBench imaging-quality score [ 24 ] , a no-reference measure of distortions such as blur and noise. For every method, CLIP and ImageReward score each view against the bare prompt “A photo of ⟨ \langle species ⟩ \rangle plants”, so that neither the object sentence nor our framing suffix affects these scores.
blocks.zh: 外观用三个图像度量法来评估,每个度量法平均在一个资产的72个视图中: CLIP得分[51](100×100\时,OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14的图像与即时嵌入的余弦相似);Image Reward [72],人类偏爱文本对图像输出的学习模型; V Bench 成像质量得分[24],这是模糊和噪音等扭曲现象的无参考度. 对于每一种方法, CLIP 和 Image Reward 都会根据赤裸的提示“ ⟨ \ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩  plants  plants  plants  plants  plants  plants  plants  plants  photo  photo  photo  photo  photo  photo  photo  photo  photo  photo  photo ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨

blocks.en: For realism , we compute the kernel distance (KD) between the rendered views and real photographs of the same species [ 6 ] . The reference set consists of photographs of the 11 bean, 3 kale and 6 mint plants of the PlantDreamer dataset described in Section 4.1 , with the background removed in the same way, excluding the photographs used to train PlantDreamer and restricted to camera elevations of − 5 ∘ -5^{\circ} to 35 ∘ 35^{\circ} to match the renders. We compute KD on Inception-v3 pool features (reported × 100 \times 100 ) and on DINOv2-B CLS features [ 47 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了现实主义,我们计算出同一物种的成像和真实照片之间的内核距离[6]. 参考集包括第4.1节描述的PlantDreamer数据集的11个豆类、3个甘蓝和6个薄荷植物的照片,其背景也以同样的方式去除,不包括用于培训PlantDreamer的照片,并且仅限于相机高度为− 5 → 5 → 5 → 5 circ}到 35 → 35 → 3 → circ}以匹配成份. 我们在Inception-v3集合特性(报告×100\times 100)和DINOv2-B CLS特性[47]上计算KD.

blocks.en: To assess shape , we score each asset against PlantDreamer’s real point clouds of the same species with the F-score [ 63 ] , after scaling both clouds to unit height and aligning them rigidly. As a generated plant is compared with a different real plant rather than with its own reference, we use a looser threshold, τ = 2 % \tau=2\% of plant height, chosen on real plants alone: two real plants of the same species score 0.66 at this threshold, against 0.54 at 1% and a saturated 0.85 at 5%. Following [ 2 ] , MMD-F averages over the real plants the F-score of the closest generated asset, measuring how closely the best generated shapes match real plants, and COV is the fraction of real plants that are the nearest neighbour of at least one generated asset, measuring how many distinct real shapes are covered. As a reference level, the real plants compared with one another reach an MMD-F of 0.659 and a COV of 0.510.
blocks.zh: 为了评估形状,我们根据PlantDreamer真实的点云与F-score[63]对每个资产进行评分,然后将两个云都缩放到单位高度,并严格地调整它们。 由于一个生成的植物与另一个真实的植物相比,而不是自己参考,我们使用一个比较松散的阈值, \\ tau=2\%的植物高度, 仅在真实的植物上选择: 同一物种的两个真实的植物在这个阈值上得分0.66, 而0.54为1%,饱和的0.85为5%. 在[2]之后,MMD-F对实际植物的平均值为最接近生成资产的F分数,衡量最佳生成的形状与实际植物的匹配程度,COV是实际植物中至少一个生成资产的近邻的一小部分,衡量覆盖了多少个不同的真实形状. 作为参考水平,相互比较的真植物达到0.659的MD-F和0.510的COV.

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that our method achieves the highest CLIP score and ImageReward, above every baseline. Our assets correspond most closely to the requested species and are the most preferred under a learned model of human preference. They are, however, less sharp than TRELLIS-text, MVDream and DiffSplat. A likely cause is that our splats are fitted to a single, nearly level orbit, so the views at the higher evaluation elevations lie outside the generated trajectory, where our reconstructions are prone to artefacts.
blocks.zh: 表4显示,我们的方法实现了最高的CLIP分数和图像奖励,高于每个基准. 我们的资产与被请求的物种最接近,并且是在人类偏爱的学习模式下最受青睐的。 然而,它们比TRELLIS-text,MVDream和DiffSplat更不尖锐. 一个可能的原因是,我们的板子被安装在一个单一的近平面轨道上,因此在较高评价高度上的观点位于生成的轨道之外,在那里我们的重建容易出现文物。

blocks.en: Realism depends on the feature space. ImageNet-trained Inception features favour texture over shape [ 15 ] , while DINOv2 features capture object structure and track human judgements more closely [ 57 ] . Using DINOv2 features, our model ranks second, behind only TRELLIS-text. Conversely, on Inception features, it ranks last among the five methods. This disparity is mainly driven by the ”mint” ( 30.54 30.54 ). Our method generates dense, bushy plants, often in terracotta pots, whereas the reference mint plants are sparse and leggy and sit in black pots.
blocks.zh: 现实主义取决于特征空间. ImageNet训练的Inception特征偏好纹理而非形状[15],而DINOv2特征则捕捉对象结构并更紧密地跟踪人类判断[57]. 使用DINOv2特性,我们的模型排名第二,仅落后于TRELLIS-text. 反之,在Inception特征上,它排在五种方法的首位. 这种差距主要是“薄荷”造成的(30.54 30.54)。 我们的方法产生茂密的,灌木丛状的植物, 经常在特拉科塔锅中, 而参考薄荷植物是稀疏的, 并坐落于黑锅中。

blocks.en: On shape, our method achieves the highest MMD-F, showing our closest generated assets match real plant shapes most accurately. However, its lower coverage indicates our shapes are less diverse across seeds than baseline outputs.
blocks.zh: 在形状上,我们的方法实现了最高的MMD-F,显示我们最接近生成的资产最准确地匹配真正的植物形状. 然而,其覆盖率较低表明,我们种子的形态差异不如基线产出。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows the generated plant samples per species for each method, together with real PlantDreamer photographs. Compared with these real plants, our assets closely resemble those of the real species, though real mint samples are noticeably taller and sparser than ours, which is consistent with our larger KD on mint.
blocks.zh: 图4显示每种方法生成的植物样本,以及真实的PlantDreamer照片。 与这些真正的植物相比,我们的资产与真正的物种非常相似,尽管真正的薄荷样品明显比我们的高且稀少,这与我们更大的薄荷KD一致.

blocks.en: In summary, although our method trails the TRELLIS-text slightly in realism, it demonstrates superior prompt adherence in generating specified plant species and achieves the most accurate structural match to real plant geometry.
blocks.zh: 简言之,虽然我们的方法在现实主义中略微跟踪到TRELLIS-文本,但它表明在生成特定植物物种方面有较强的迅速坚持性,并实现了最精确的结构匹配与真正的植物几何.

blocks.en: 5.3 Synthetic Fruit Counting Experiments
blocks.zh: 5.3 合成水果计数实验

blocks.en: To test whether a fine-grained attribute specified in the prompt is preserved in 3D, we prompt each method for a given number of fruit, using “A photo of ⟨ \langle species ⟩ \rangle plants with ⟨ N ⟩ \langle N\rangle ⟨ \langle fruit ⟩ \rangle . Single potted plant, whole plant.” (e.g. “with five tomatoes”). We write N N as a word, since text-to-image models follow number words more accurately than digits [ 26 ] , which we also observed for Qwen-Image-2.1 in a pilot study. We generate tomato and lemon plants for N = 1 N=1 to 7 7 with seeds 42, 1 and 2, giving 42 assets per method. As in Section 5.2 , our method receives the same content prompt followed by the framing suffix.
blocks.zh: 为了测试在提示中指定的精细的属性是否保存在3D中,我们用“  \ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩  plants  plants  plants  plants  plants  plants  plants  plants  plants ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟩ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟩ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟨ ⟩ ⟩  ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ ⟩ 单一盆栽植物,全株。” 我们把N N 写成一个单词,因为文本对图像模型跟随数字单词比数字 [26] 更准确,我们还在试点研究中观察到了Quen-Image-2.1. 我们为N=1N=1至7 7生产番茄和柠檬植物,种子42、1和2,每个方法有42个资产。 与第5.2节一样,我们的方法收到同样的内容,然后是框架后缀。

blocks.en: Fruit are counted by eye by one author, blind to the requested number and method, from rendered views covering each asset from all sides. Each distinct fruit of any colour is counted once, including fused, detached and blurred fruit, but not colour on a leaf or stem and specks visible from only one angle. A second author, independently re-counted one asset per method, species and N N (84 of the 252 assets) and 14 of the 42 input images. The two counters agreed exactly on 91.7% of the assets (Krippendorff’s α = 0.98 \alpha=0.98 [ 28 ] ) and on all 14 input images. Every disagreement concerned the ill-formed fruit of DiffSplat (5 of 14 assets) or MVDream (2 of 14), yet none changed whether an asset matched the requested number, so each method’s exact-count rate on the subset is the same under either counter. Table 5 uses the reported counts of the first counter.
blocks.zh: 果实由一位作者按眼睛计算,无视要求的数字和方法,从各方对每项资产的看法中得出。 每种不同颜色的果实都计算一次,包括引信、脱落和模糊的果实,但不包括只从一个角度可见的叶片或茎和斑点的颜色。 第二作者,独立重算了每方法,物种和N(252个资产中的84个)和42个输入图像中的14个资产. 两个柜台完全商定了91.7%的资产(Krippendorff的α=0.98\alpha=0.98[28]),以及所有14个输入图像。 每一项分歧都涉及DiffSplat(14个资产中的5个)或MVDream(14个资产中的2个)的不完善结果,但没有任何一项改变某一资产是否与所要求的数字相符,因此每种方法在子集上的确切计算率在两个计数器下都是一样的。 表5使用第一个计数器的报数。

blocks.en: We report the percentage of the percentage of assets whose counted fruit equals the requested N N (Exact Number Generation), the mean absolute count error (MAE) and, for our method and TRELLIS.2, the percentage whose 3D count matches their input image ( = = input). CLIP, ImageReward and VQAScore [ 36 ] , which uses a vision-language model to estimate the probability that an image shows the prompt, are averaged over the 72 views and computed without the count (e.g. “A photo of tomato plants with tomatoes”), so that they measure image quality and the presence of fruit.
blocks.zh: 我们报告计算结果等于要求的N N(精确数字生成)、平均绝对计数错误(MAE)以及对于我们的方法和TRELLIS.2,3D计数与其输入图像(===输入)相符的资产百分比。 CLIP,Image Reward and VQAScore [36],它使用视觉语言模型来估计一个图像显示提示的概率,平均在72个视图上进行,在没有计数(如"番茄植物与番茄的照片")的情况下进行计算,从而测量图像质量和果实的存在.

blocks.en: Our method preserves the fruit count of its input image in 40 of the 42 assets (95.2%; Table 5 ).The two exceptions are both tomato assets whose input image shows six fruit and whose 3D asset gains one, giving seven (see Fig. 5 ). For the N = 6 N=6 asset, this turns a correct count into an error, while for the N = 7 N=7 asset it turns an error into a correct count. The two changes cancel out, so our Exact Number Generation and MAE are identical to those of the input images. TRELLIS.2, lifting the same images, preserves the count in only 23 of 42 assets (54.8%), and 18 of its 19 errors add fruit. We attribute this difference to how each method uses the input image. In our pipeline, the input image is pinned as the first and last frame of the orbit video, which only moves the camera around a static scene (Section 3.1 ), so the visible fruit are carried into the splat. TRELLIS.2 instead uses the image only as conditioning and generates the whole asset, including its hidden side, from its 3D prior, leaving it free to add fruit.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法在42项资产中的40项(95.2%)保留了输入图像的果实计数(表5)。 这两个例外都是番茄资产,其输入图像显示6个果实,其3D资产获得1个,给出7个(见图5)。 对于N = 6 N = 6资产,这把一个正确的计数变成一个错误,而对于N = 7 N = 7资产,它把一个错误变成一个正确的计数. 这两个更改取消,所以我们的精确数字生成和MAE与输入图像完全相同. TRELLIS.2,抬起相同的图像,仅保留42个资产中的23个(54.8%)的计数,其19个错误中的18个加果. 我们将此差异归因于每种方法如何使用输入图像. 在我们的管道中,输入图像被固定为轨道视频的第一和最后一帧,它只将相机绕着静态场景移动(第3.1节),因此可见的果实被带入浮标. TRELLIS.2转而只使用图像作为条件,并从3D前端生成整个资产,包括其隐藏的侧面,使其可以自由添加水果.

blocks.en: Because our 3D counts follow the input images so closely, our remaining errors originate in the text-to-image stage. As Fig. 5 shows, these errors depend on the species, with tomato images having at most one fruit too few and lemon images up to two too many, and they become more frequent as N N grows.
blocks.zh: 因为我们的3D计数 紧跟输入图像, 我们剩下的错误 起源于文本到图像的阶段。 如图5所示,这些错误取决于物种,番茄图象最多只有一种水果太少,柠檬图象最多有两种,随着NN的生长,它们变得更加频繁.

blocks.en: End-to-end, our method achieves the highest Exact Number Generation and the lowest MAE of all methods. Notably, TRELLIS-text, which produced the most realistic renders in Section 5.2 , never produces the requested count (0.0%, MAE 3.62), as it mostly omits the fruit altogether (Fig. 5 ). On the quality metrics, our method achieves the highest VQAScore, close to that of its input images, and ranks second on CLIP and ImageReward, behind TRELLIS.2. These differences are small, and as TRELLIS.2 is rendered as a textured mesh and our method as a splat, they may partly reflect the different output representations.
blocks.zh: 端到端,我们的方法实现了所有方法中最高的精确数生成和最低的MAE. 值得注意的是,第5.2节中最现实的TRELLIS文本从未产生所要求的数量(0.0%,MAE 3.62),因为它大多完全省略了果实(图5)。 在质量度量标准上,我们的方法实现了最高的VQAScore,接近其输入图像,并在CLIP和图像奖励上排名第二,落后于TRELLIS.2. 这些差异很小,由于TRELLIS.2作为纹理网格和我们的方法作为板块来提供,它们可能部分反映了不同的输出表示.

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows examples for N = 3 N=3 and N = 6 N=6 . The text-to-3D baselines often generate malformed or missing fruit, and mostly match the requested count at a rate close to or below random chance (14.3%). These failures are consistent with the observation in Section 2 that text-to-3D models, trained on far less data than text-to-image models, offer little control over specific plant traits. Our method and TRELLIS.2 avoid this limitation by starting from an image generated by a strong text-to-image model.
blocks.zh: 图6显示了N=3 N=3和N=6 N=6的例子。 文本到-3D的基线往往产生畸形或缺失的果实,并且大多以接近或低于随机概率(14.3%)的速度与请求的计数吻合. 这些失败与第2节中的意见是一致的,即文本到3D模型在数据比文本到图像模型少得多的训练下,对特定的植物特征几乎没有控制. 我们的方法和TRELLIS.2通过从一个强大的文本到图像模型生成的图像开始来避免这种限制.

blocks.en: Overall, our method follows the requested fruit count more accurately than every text-to-3D baseline and almost always preserves the count of its input image, so its accuracy is limited mainly by the text-to-image model and should improve with it.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的方法比每个文本到3D基线更准确地遵循所请求的果实计数,并且几乎总是保留其输入图像的计数,因此其准确度主要受到文本到图像模型的限制,应该随之而改进.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Advantages over existing methods
blocks.zh: 6.1 现有方法的优点

blocks.en: We believe that Plant Orbiter presents several advantages over existing approaches to 3D reconstruction of plants. Firstly, monocular methods of 3D reconstruction present numerous practical advantages for phenotyping applications. High throughput pipelines, like those normally used in plant science and agriculture, must work efficiently and at scale, making capture using complex imaging setups or expensive robots impractical. Efficient, one or few shot reconstruction approaches, captured with a handheld camera present a much more practical approach in a wide range of settings.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,植物轨道器在植物的立体重建方面比现有方法具有若干优势。 首先,立体重建的单体方法为麻黄应用提供了许多实际的优点。 高吞吐量管道,像植物科学和农业中通常使用的管道一样,必须高效和大规模地工作,使利用复杂的成像装置或昂贵的机器人捕获不切实际。 用手持相机拍摄到的高效、一到几个镜头式的重建方法,在各种环境中呈现出一种更为实际的方法。

blocks.en: Relative to other generation methods such as TRELLIS or Hunyuan3D, our work offers a substantial practical advantage by being able to easy align the model to its input image; even with respect to other video diffusion models, the ability to predict camera poses based on the known path provides computational benefits at scale.
blocks.zh: 相对于其他生成方法,如TRELLIS或Hunyuan3D,我们的工作通过能够轻松地将模型与其输入图像对齐,提供了实质性的实用优势;即使对于其他视频传播模型,基于已知路径预测相机所浮现的能力在规模上提供了计算效益.

blocks.en: When compared to other reconstruction from video, including real and synthetic methods like SEVA or SV3D, which inherit part of our pipeline, our method beats both methods across a majority of the evaluations conducted. Our strongest results against these methods come from Shape and Perceptual measures, for which we beat SEVA in all tests, and SV3D in all but one. All three video methods use our known poses and therefore skip the lengthy COLMAP process, a stage that can often lead to reconstruction failure. For complex plant scenes it is often challenging to reconstruct camera poses using COLMAP, and the inclusion of our known pose approach greatly strengthens this family of methods.
blocks.zh: 相比于其他来自视频的重建,包括像SEVA或SV3D这样的真正和合成方法,它们继承了我们管线的一部分,我们的方法在进行的大多数评价中都胜过这两种方法. 与这些方法相比,我们最强的结果来自形状和观念措施,我们在所有测试中战胜了SEVA,除了一个之外,所有测试中都战胜了SV3D. 所有三种视频方法都使用我们已知的姿势,因此跳过漫长的COLMAP进程,这个阶段往往会导致重建失败. 对于复杂的植物场景来说,使用COLMAP来重建相机外观往往具有挑战性,而纳入我们已知的姿势方法极大地加强了这个方法家族.

blocks.en: For text-to-3D generation, our results suggest that the priors of 2D and video models can stand in for scarce 3D training data. The text-to-image model provides control over the species and traits of the plant, such as the number of fruit, and the video model, by orbiting the input image rather than regenerating the plant, carries that control into 3D. The prompt therefore remains an accurate label for the generated plant, as labelled synthetic data for phenotyping requires, and the pipeline should benefit directly from future text-to-image models.
blocks.zh: 对于文本到3D生成,我们的结果显示,2D和视频模型的前身可以代表稀缺的3D训练数据. 文字到图像模型通过绕着输入图像而不是再生植物来控制植物的物种和特征,如水果数量,视频模型则将这种控制带入3D. 因此,这种速率仍然是所生成的植物的准确标签,正如带标签的麻黄碱合成数据所要求的那样,管道应直接受益于未来的文本到图像模型。

blocks.en: For both reconstruction and generative pipelines we present, our method is especially of interest as it achieves these results without any plant specific training. Many generative [ 17 ] models for plants require training from plant specific datasets that are often species and setup dependant, meaning that these models do not generalise well to unseen cases. By contrast, our method performs well across a wide variety of plant species without requiring additional training.
blocks.zh: 对于我们所介绍的重建和基因管道来说,我们的方法特别有意义,因为它在没有经过任何植物特定培训的情况下取得了这些结果。 许多植物的基因[17]模型需要从植物特定数据集中培训,这些数据集往往是物种和被设置的依附者,这意味着这些模型不能很好地概括到看不见的情况。 相比之下,我们的方法在各种植物物种中表现良好,不需要更多的培训。

blocks.en: 6.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.2 限制

blocks.en: The biggest limitation of this work is that in phenotyping pipelines, monocular approaches can only capture details included in the input image, and details of the reverse side, or occluded features must be inferred. For this reason our method is best suited to specific use cases, like height measurement as shown in the paper, and specific plants that do not self occlude significantly.
blocks.zh: 这项工作最大的局限是,在麻黄管中,单体方法只能捕捉输入图像中包含的细节,必须推断出反面的细节,或斜面特征. 因此,我们的方法最适合具体使用的情况,如纸张中显示的高度测量,以及没有明显自我占有的特定植物。

blocks.en: Another limitation of our method is that the current path predicted captures a single orbit of the plant at a static height. Since Gaussian splatting is trained from this video from the specific orbital perspective, the reconstructions often have artefacts and loss of realism, when viewed from above and below. Though the impact of this limitation will vary in importance depending on the specific downstream phenotyping task being attempted.
blocks.zh: 我们方法的另一个局限性是,目前预测的路径以静态高度捕捉植物的单个轨道. 由于高斯滑板是从这个视频中从具体的轨道角度来训练的,所以重建时往往有手工艺品和失去现实主义,从上到下来看. 虽然这种限制的影响在重要性上会有所不同,但取决于正在尝试的具体下游铺设任务。

blocks.en: 6.3 Future Work
blocks.zh: 6.3 未来工作

blocks.en: One of the primary limitations of any monocular approach is that the rear view of the plant will, by the nature of this approach, be invented. As such, a video diffusion model that takes an additional image of the reverse view of the plant may be required for further phenotyping tasks, or dense plant structures where additional knowledge of the far side is required. An adapted version of our model that pins an additional view could allow for this, but would need to overcome additional challenges in plant consistency, and the ability to determine the placement of the camera in relation to each other, and track the camera path between them.
blocks.zh: 任何单体方法的主要限制之一是,根据这种方法的性质,厂家的后视线将被发明出来. 因此,可能需要一种视频传播模型,对植物的反向视图进行额外图像,以便开展进一步的麻黄工作,或者在需要更多了解远方的植物结构时,需要增加这种知识。 我们的模型的改编版将增加一个视图,可以允许这样做,但需要克服工厂一致性方面的更多挑战,以及确定相机彼此相对位置的能力,并跟踪相机之间的相机路径.

blocks.en: Additional work on synthetic data generated this way is also highly promising. Compared to other methods of generating synthetic plant data, for example, procedural generative methods, a crucial advantage of text-to-3D generative models is the ability to prompt for specific phenotypic characteristics easily. Further investigation into the level of accuracy (in the case of geometric measures) or realism when generating physiological phenotypes that can be achieved with our method could strengthen our methods potential for synthetic data generation.
blocks.zh: 以这种方式生成的关于合成数据的其他工作也是很有希望的。 与其他生成合成植物数据的方法相比,例如程序基因方法,文本到3D基因模型的一个关键优势是能够轻松地促进特定的异构特征. 进一步调查精确度(在几何测量方面)或现实度,在产生可以用我们的方法实现的生理苯基时,可以加强我们合成数据生成方法的潜力.

blocks.en: 6.4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6.4 结论

blocks.en: In this paper we have presented Plant Orbiter, to our knowledge the first monocular 3D reconstruction method for plants using video diffusion. Our experimental results show that our method competes strongly against existing SotA methods, often exceeding their performance in crucial metrics such as 3D geometry across varied datasets.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了植物轨道器, 据我们所知,这是植物使用视频传播的第一种单光谱立体重建方法。 我们的实验结果显示,我们的方法与现有的SotA方法竞争激烈,常常超过它们在各种数据集的三维几何等关键指标上的性能.

blocks.en: Our method generates a short 73 frame video around a target plant, from which we generate a 3D Gaussian splat, using the known orbit from around the plant to predict accurate camera positions and easily align the generated 3D plant. When tested on plants from a wide variety of species, we find we are able to achieve the highest accuracy in IoU and DISTS for most datasets and the best F-scores on all tested datasets. We demonstrate how this method can be used to measure real world plant traits such as plant height and achieve a mean height error of just 5.9% (0.9-2.3cm) across our experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法在目标工厂周围生成一个短的73帧视频,我们从中生成一个3D高斯板,利用工厂周围已知的轨道来预测准确的相机位置,并方便地对齐生成的3D工厂. 在对来自多种物种的植物进行测试时,我们发现我们能够在IoU和DISTS中达到大多数数据集的最高精度,在所有测试数据集上达到最好的F分数. 我们示范如何使用这种方法来测量植物高度等真实世界植物特征, 并在我们的实验中实现5.9%(0.9-2.3厘米)的平均高度误差。

blocks.en: By prepending a text-to-image model, the same pipeline also generates 3D plants from text, inheriting the prompt adherence of 2D models without requiring scarce 3D training data. Among the text-to-3D methods tested, it best matches both the requested species and the shapes of real plants, reproduces a desired number of fruit accurately, and preserves the fruit count of its input image in 95% of assets.
blocks.zh: 通过预置文本到图像模型,同一管道还从文本中生成3D厂房,继承了2D模型的迅速遵守,而不需要稀缺的3D训练数据. 在测试的文本到3D方法中,它最符合所请求的物种和真植物的形状,准确地复制了想要的数量的水果,并保留了95%资产中输入图像的果实计数.

blocks.en: Overall, these results show an accurate and realistic new way to reconstruct digital twins, perform 3D phenotyping, and generate synthetic data using a method not yet applied in this field, while also providing meaningful practical benefits to users.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果表明了重建数码双胞胎,进行3D phenotyping的准确而现实的新方式,并使用这个领域尚未应用的方法生成合成数据,同时也为用户提供了有意义的实际好处.
